title: East Lansing Public Schools
description: The district publishes a land acknowledgement on its website. “The High School resides on Land ceded in the 1819 Treaty of Saginaw. We recognize and uplift the sovereignty of the twelve federally-recognized nations in Michigan and all other legally unrecognized nations.” Yet they haven’t suggested giving back the land.
